t: What he said about Abu Bakr in the same sermon
a: إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنَ النَّاسِ أَحَدٌ أَمَنَّ عَلَىَّ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ مِنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ
p: Innahu laysa mina-n-nāsi aḥadun amanna ʿalayya fī nafsihi wa mālihi min Abī Bakri-bni Abī Quḥāfah
m: There is no one among people who has been more generous to me with himself and his wealth than Abu Bakr ibn Abi Quhafah.
